senses.gloss:
लष् लष् (akin to 1. लस्, cf. लालस), i. 1 and 4, Par. To desire; cf. 2. लस्.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि,
 1. To desire, Vikr. 13, 20; to covet, Hit. 69, 5; MBh. 1, 6580.
 2. To take, Vikr. d. 107. अभिलषित, n. Desire, Hit. 95, 4, M.M.
 --Cf. λῶ, λῆμα, λαρός, λωΐων, λίαν, λιλαίομαι, λήλαντος, probably λαμία, λάμος, λάρυγξ, λαιμός, λαίτμα, etc.; Lat. lascivus; Goth. luston, lustus; A.S. lust, lyst, lystan.

1. लस् लस्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To embrace.
 2. To sport or play.
 3. To shine, MBh. 3, 15533.
 --Caus. लासय, To cause to sport, to move, Vikr. d. 23.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्,
 1. To sport, Pañc. i. d. 152; Bhaṭṭ. 9, 86.
 2. To shine, Śiś. 20, 56.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to shine, Ṛt. 6, 8.
 2. To delight, Hit. 21, 15.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To shine, Śiś. 2, 19.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्,
 1. To break forth, Pañc. ii. d. 193.
 2. To [] shine forth, Śiś. 8, 65.
 3. To sport. समुल्लसित,
 1. Sportive.
 2. Beautiful.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To sport, to dally, Hit. 42, 9; with उपरि in उपरि-वि-लसन्त्, Flashing up, Megh. 48.
 2. To play, to exhibit, Pañc. iii. d. 237.
 3. To shine, Bhartṛ. 3, 23; 36 (to flash); Pañc. i. d. 461 (येन विलसितम्, Who has lived in a brilliant style). विलसित, Sportive, wanton. n.
 1. Wanton pastime.
 2. Splendour. Kir. 5, 46; flashing, Vikr. d. 137.
 --Comp.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To break forth, Lass. 24, 14.
 --Cf. probably Lat. ludo; see लष्.
† 2. लस् लस्, लष् लष्, लश् लश्, i. 10, Par. To do anything skilfully.
लस्तक लस्तक, perhaps लस्त + क (1. लस्, To embrace). m. The middle of a bow.

लास लास, i. e. लस् + अ, m.
 1. Dancing. []
 2. Dalliance.
 3. Pea-water, pulse that has been lightly boiled.

लासक लासक, i. e. लस् + अक,
 I. m.
 1. A dancer, an actor.
 2. A peacock.
 II. f. अका and इका, A dancing girl.

लास्य लास्य, i. e. लास + य,
 I. m. A dancer.
 II. f. या, A female dancer.
 III. n.
 1. Dancing.
 2. Union of dance and music, Mārk. P. 68, 26.
 3. The dance of the Indian dancing girls.
